title: Kazakhstan's transition from commodity corridor to investable Eurasian infrastructure platform
deck: Financed rail expansion, power reform and new Asian resource partnerships are beginning to connect Kazakhstan's commodity base to logistics, processing and private capital.
regime: Infrastructure-led diversification under persistent inflation and a large state footprint
key_risk: Private capital may lag public infrastructure if inflation, quasi-fiscal activity or investor-state disputes remain elevated.
watch: Middle Corridor freight and transit times
search_text: Kazakhstan strategic transition Middle Corridor rail logistics energy critical minerals Korea investment reform wages 2026
selection_rationale: Material financed rail and power investment is converging with market and utility reforms and new Korean agreements in nuclear energy, oil, critical minerals and technology. The transition is less covered than its potential effect on Eurasian trade, resource processing and private-capital mobilisation, and the transmission mechanisms run through transport costs, electricity capacity, investment conditions and household real incomes.

title: Quantum Computing in 2026: Real Progress, Economic Utility Still Under Validation
deck: Error correction has advanced and post-quantum migration is already driving concrete decisions, but a fault-tolerant machine with independently verified economic utility has not yet been demonstrated.
regime: Measurable scientific and engineering progress without demonstrated fault-tolerant economic utility at industrial scale
key_risk: Vendor roadmaps and isolated technical metrics may be mistaken for independently demonstrated economic utility.
